title: Kar diya islam
body:
ya hussain as salaam
as salaam ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
kar diya islam ko hai surkh roo shabbir ne
is ki khaatir ki hai aisi justuju shabbir ne
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh mein aansu thay har ek ki shabe ashoor ko
ki hai is andaaz se guftugu shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
leke aaye thay layeen jo karbala ke dasht mein
khaak mein wo sab mila di aarzoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na kiya na kar sakega koi ghazi is tarha
khoon mein jaise kiya hai wazoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kufr ke haathon ye deen ke chid gaye thay jo libaas
wo zibha sab kar diye hai wo rufoo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ameer is deen ki khaatir bala ke dasht mein
kar diye qurban bete khoon baroo shabbir ne
kar diya islam ko hai...
author: Ameer Hussain Mashadi
